decision_so_far: The maintainer selected a browser-persisted preference using localStorage. Fahrenheit must apply to temperature, dew point, and heat index in current readings, chart axes, tooltips, and extrema.
options: A session-only Celsius/Fahrenheit control in the web app. It resets on page reload.
A Celsius/Fahrenheit control persisted in the browser for the same device and browser.
A user-account preference persisted by the backend.
recommendation: Option B was confirmed by the maintainer.

next_steps.option: Create and implement a scoped story for the browser-persisted display preference.
